mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 40 degrees with clear skies near Fireman's Park and a New Moon tonight.

The city announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11 affecting Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street, plus the Plan Commission will review new development projects for Liberty Business Park on December 7.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, live music tomorrow at Lake Lou-ee, and yoga happening tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers arrested a man for his first offence of O W I after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton and Rita.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl, and you can grab it when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
